gui.torcherino.config.title: Torcherino Settings
gui.torcherino.config.serverReload:
Recipe switches need a restart or /reload.
The black lists and the performance switches apply immediately.
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.maxAcceler:
When on, caps the acceleration calls one Torcherino may spend per tick.
Off by default (uncapped); the value is preset to 16384 and can be changed.
Turn it on when it lags - smaller values are cheaper.
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.adaptiveTh:
Scales the acceleration down while the server is slow,
and returns to full speed once it recovers.
Off by default: your configured speed is played back exactly.
gui.torcherino.config.serverNote: Note: in multiplayer, if you lack the permission you are changing this computer's own configuration.
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.maxAcceler:
When on, caps the whole mod per tick, split over all Torcherinos.
Off by default (uncapped); the value is preset to 65536.
Use it when the per Torcherino cap is not enough.
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.skipSatura:
LOWERS THE RATE, OFF BY DEFAULT.
Positions that stopped changing get one call per tick,
and return to full speed as soon as something moves.
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.probabilis:
ON BY DEFAULT since 1.4.1.
One call with chance N x randomTickSpeed / 4096 instead of N calls per position.
Expected growth matches and the cost stops scaling with the multiplier; turn it off for the old behaviour.
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.ownerOnlyW:
When on, a Torcherino only runs while its owner is online.
Torcherinos without a recorded owner keep running.
Off by default.
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.adaptiveTh:
A tick slower than this counts as slow.
Default 50 ms (the TPS 20 warning line).
Raise it when your pack is slower by nature.

How far the brake may slow things down.
Example: 256 -> at most 1/256 of the configured speed.
Smaller values brake harder. Default 256.
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.statsLogIn:
Writes one stats line to the server log every N seconds.
Read it in <instance>/logs/latest.log, search for Torcherino stats.
0 = silent (default).
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.blackliste:
Blocks that must not be accelerated, one per line, as modid:block.
Example: minecraft:grass_block

Block entities that must not be accelerated, one per line.
Example: net.minecraft.world.level.
block.entity.ChestBlockEntity
gui.torcherino.owner.permission.tip:
Click to switch whether other players may change this Torcherino.
It only affects editing, never the acceleration itself.
gui.torcherino.owner.unclaim.tip:
Click to drop the claim.
After that, whoever places it becomes the owner.
message.torcherino.locked: This Torcherino has an owner, you are not allowed to edit it
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.skipSatura: May stop some positions from being accelerated - enable with care
gui.torcherino.config.tooltip.ownerSyste:
OFF BY DEFAULT. When on, placing a Torcherino claims it for you:
the editor shows the owner row and the unclaim / permission buttons.
When off, nothing is claimed and every player may edit; old claims are kept but ignored.
torcherino.configuration.title: Torcherino Settings
torcherino.configuration.gui.useGui.tool: Open the graphical editor when right clicking a Torcherino. Off = the classic quick interaction.
torcherino.configuration.gui.freeSpeedMu: Let the speed slider move continuously between steps. The shown value still rounds to a whole step.
Print a chat notice about the configuration every time you join a world.
torcherino.configuration.general.overPow: Use the cheap recipe instead of the nether star one. Needs a restart or /reload.
torcherino.configuration.general.compres: Enable the recipes of the Compressed tier. Needs a restart or /reload.
torcherino.configuration.general.doubleC: Enable the recipes of the Double Compressed tier. Requires the Compressed tier.
torcherino.configuration.general.tripleC: Enable the recipes of the Triple Compressed tier. Requires the two lower tiers.
torcherino.configuration.general.maxAcce: Cap the acceleration calls a single Torcherino may spend per tick. Off = uncapped.
Maximum calls per Torcherino per tick. 0 = unlimited. Only read while the cap above is on.
Cap the whole mod per tick, shared by every Torcherino. Off = uncapped.
Maximum calls for the whole mod per tick. 0 = unlimited. Only read while the global cap is on.
torcherino.configuration.general.adaptiv: Slow the acceleration down while the server tick is slow, and return to full speed when it recovers.
Tick duration above which the brake starts. 50 ms is the TPS 20 warning line.
How far the brake may slow things down. 256 = at most 1/256 of the configured speed.
torcherino.configuration.general.skipSat: LOWERS THE RATE. Positions that stop changing get one call per tick until something moves.
torcherino.configuration.general.probabi: One call with the chance N x randomTickSpeed / 4096 instead of N calls. Same expected growth, much cheaper.
torcherino.configuration.general.ownerSy: Master switch of the owner system. Off: nothing is claimed, everybody may edit, no owner line.
torcherino.configuration.general.ownerOn: A claimed Torcherino only runs while its owner is online. Unclaimed ones always run.
torcherino.configuration.general.statsLo: Write one stats line to the server log every N seconds. 0 = silent.
torcherino.configuration.blacklist.black: Blocks the Torcherino may never accelerate. Format: modid:block
Block entity classes the Torcherino may never accelerate. Format: full class name
